title: It is not ready yet
subtitle: Rui builds frameworks. His product is three components away, and that is fine: the route is to ship the component.
by: startups.engineer, 20 October 2026, a first strip for Dinis to review
rule: The Finder's questions, the board of excuses, the rule of the finder and the route title are finder.json's strings word for word (from_finder); the build checks them. Rui's and the Guide's lines are the storyboard's words.

scenes.title: It is not ready yet
scenes.subtitle: The author's own path, through Rui: a component builder ships the component.
scenes.note: From the memo: 'I'm a framework guy ... I arrive at my profitable and effective startups three, four startups later and X components later. I think that's okay.'

scenes.caption: The ship stage

cast.says: What is the smallest version a stranger could use this week?
The library, I suppose. The product is not there yet.

scenes.note: Question ship.smallest. Held together with tape is fine; nobody using it cares how it was built.

scenes.caption: Every excuse in the book, listed, so you can pick yours

lines: One more feature, then it is ready
I have not asked anyone to use it
I need money, people or permission first
Showing it before it is good
Nothing. I could ship this week

scenes.note: The six options of question ship.blocker, as the file has them. The blocker is a signal, not a judgement.

scenes.caption: What the finder does not do

evidence.quote: We are not passing judgement. The right startup for a person is the one they are passionate about and will keep working on. What we help with is focus, and shipping: something a stranger can use, now.

scenes.note: Decision 003, in the file's words. The route is a direction of travel, not a verdict.

scenes.caption: The signals, the rule, the route

cast.says: A component builder with no product yet ships the component.

scenes.note: The rule's because line, from the file. The same answers give the same route on the page, in a model and in the test.

scenes.caption: Three or four startups and a number of components later is a path, not a failure

cast.says: Open source, this week. A package name is the whole distribution.

scenes.note: The route title is finder.json's (from_finder on the punchline). Watch who uses it; the product is in what they ask for next.
